source_en: Hello. ...You are new. Emzar Jalaghonia. I keep track of faces.
I assist the beekeeper. East side. ...The master runs the hives.
He does not use one. ...He says names make people complicated.
Near. ...The bees stay inside since then. They are waiting for something.
My [[infected:chest has been tight]]. Dust from the site, the foreman says.
The polyclinic line is long. ...The master says hurrying gets people stung.
Stings, mostly. ...Some I do not remember getting.
